title: Tonbo Imaging India IPO Details
intro:
Tonbo Imaging India IPO is a book build issue of ₹852.18 crores. The issue is entirely an offer for sale of 1.22 crore shares of ₹852.18 crore.

Tonbo Imaging India IPO bidding opened for subscription on Oct 15, 2026 and will close on Oct 19, 2026. The allotment for the Tonbo Imaging India IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 21, 2026. Tonbo Imaging India IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 23, 2026.

Tonbo Imaging India IPO is set issue price band at ₹665 to ₹700 per share. The lot size for an application is 21 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,700 (21 shares) (based on upper price).

JM Financial Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Tonbo Imaging India IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in December 2003, Tonbo Imaging India Limited is a global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer (OEM) engaged in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced electro-optic, infrared (EO/IR), embedded vision, communication, guidance, and surveillance systems for defence and security applications. The company offers a diversified portfolio of battlefield solutions, including thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, missile seekers, fire control systems, missile guidance systems, targeting systems, and handheld thermal imaging devices.

Tonbo serves defence and security organizations across 24 countries with over 28,000 field-deployed systems. The company is India's largest manufacturer of thermal imaging systems for government and defence agencies (FY24–FY26) and the country's largest exporter of thermal imaging systems by volume. Its products are developed using fully owned intellectual property and are free from ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) restrictions, enabling exports to global markets without geopolitical limitations.

The company operates an innovation-driven business model backed by strong in-house R&D, proprietary technologies, and advanced manufacturing capabilities. As an approved supplier under India's IDDM (Indigenously Designed, Developed and Manufactured) defence procurement framework, Tonbo supports the Government's 'Make in India' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiatives.
As of June 30, 2026, the company employed 339 permanent employees across product design & development, manufacturing, project management, sales, finance, HR, and management functions.
strengths: Leading defence electronics OEM with proprietary electro-optic and thermal imaging technologies.
Strong in-house R&D capabilities with complete ownership of core intellectual property.
Diversified portfolio of battlefield surveillance, targeting, guidance, and imaging solutions.
Global presence with 28,000+ deployed systems across 24 countries and ITAR-free export capability.
Asset-light, innovation-driven business model supported by healthy financial performance.
Experienced management team with deep expertise in defence technology and product development.

Incorporated in December 2003, Tonbo Imaging India Limited is a global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer (OEM) engaged in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced electro-optic, infrared (EO/IR), embedded vision, communication, guidance, and surveillance systems for defence and security applications. The company offers a diversified portfolio of battlefield solutions, including thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, missile seekers, fire control systems, missile guidance systems, targeting systems, and handheld thermal imaging devices.

Tonbo serves defence and security organizations across 24 countries with over 28,000 field-deployed systems. The company is India's largest manufacturer of thermal imaging systems for government and defence agencies (FY24–FY26) and the country's largest exporter of thermal imaging systems by volume. Its products are developed using fully owned intellectual property and are free from ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) restrictions, enabling exports to global markets without geopolitical limitations.

The company operates an innovation-driven business model backed by strong in-house R&D, proprietary technologies, and advanced manufacturing capabilities. As an approved supplier under India's IDDM (Indigenously Designed, Developed and Manufactured) defence procurement framework, Tonbo supports the Government's 'Make in India' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiatives.

As of June 30, 2026, the company employed 339 permanent employees across product design & development, manufacturing, project management, sales, finance, HR, and management functions.

Tonbo Imaging India Ltd.'s revenue decreased by 22% and profit after tax (PAT) dropped by 30% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

The Tonbo Imaging India Ltd. IPO is a 100% Offer for Sale (OFS), so the company will not receive any funding and the entire IPO proceeds will go to the selling shareholders.

The company offers a diversified portfolio of battlefield solutions, including thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, missile seekers, fire control systems, missile guidance systems, targeting systems, and handheld thermal imaging devices. Products: Tactical systems: These systems are focused on the functions of imaging, surveillance, reconnaissance and targeting. Platform systems: Two kinds of platform systems – (a) subsystems that can provide observation and fire control capabilities to a range of aerial, ground and weapon platforms and (b) end platforms that actually perform the task of threat neutralization. Directed energy systems: To counter the threat of drone swarms, they have designed a portfolio of technology components that are being assembled into a high power microwave (“HPM”) platform with the brand name - WaveStrike. Tonbo serves defence and security organizations across 24 countries with over 28,000 field-deployed systems. As an approved supplier under India's IDDM (Indigenously Designed, Developed and Manufactured) defence procurement framework, Tonbo supports the Government's 'Make in India' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiatives. faqs.question: How to apply in Tonbo Imaging India IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Tonbo Imaging India IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Tonbo Imaging India IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Tonbo Imaging India IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Tonbo Imaging India IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
